notes: Fixed section reviewed and accepted: 111 duplicate nodes removed (last-wins), 20 bare-path prefixes added, 3 tested_by edges flipped correctly, 4 orphan tested_by edges dropped. No systemic anomalies.

Removed 69 low-quality nodes from the assembled graph: 49 'schema' type nodes that were duplicates of 'file:' nodes (one per migration), 20 'data' type nodes that were graphify AST cache entries (file:data:graphify-out/cache/ast/...), and 20 'config' type graphify-internal metadata files.

After node removal, 94 table nodes became orphaned because they had been connected via 'defines_schema' edges from the now-removed 'schema' type nodes. Restored connectivity by adding 94 new 'defines_schema' edges from the corresponding 'file:' migration nodes to their tables.
Cleaned 2 dangling edges that referenced removed .qoder config nodes.

All 12 migrations 33-49 that had only schema-type orphan nodes (no file node) have lost their schema entity. These migrations modify tables created in earlier migrations, so this is acceptable - the tables still exist via the 'file:' nodes of the originating migrations.

Final graph: 559 nodes, 1009 edges. Node types: file(117), function(179), class(19), table(95), config(2), document(147). No 'data' or 'schema' types remain. Zero dangling edges, zero self-referential edges, zero duplicate edges, zero missing fields.

Remaining 70 orphans: 1 config (.env.example - legitimate, no docs pointing to it), 60 documents (all .qoder/ auto-generated wiki content - no semantic edges), 9 files (graphify-out/2026-08-27/ internal cache, .ua/.understandignore, .graphify_labels.json.sig, .graphify_root, scripts/gen_types.ts, supabase/.branches/_current_branch, and 3 graphify-out 2026-08-23 metadata files).
Remaining orphans are all legitimate: project files without semantic connections, generated wiki docs without source-file links, and graphify internal metadata. No data quality fix needed for these.
Edge weights verified semantically appropriate: imports=0.7, exports=0.8, calls=0.8, defines_schema=0.9, contains=1.0, documents=0.5.
tested_by edges correctly point production -> test with direction=forward, weight=0.5. No test->test or prod->prod pairs.
All migration files correctly have defines_schema edges to their tables, and all tables (95/95) have at least one edge in the final graph.

The 'data' node type is invalid in this graph schema. All 20 instances were graphify AST cache entries and have been removed. If the schema supports 'data' as a legitimate type, the merge script should normalize it. If not, the upstream LLM should not emit this type.
summary: Review complete. The assembled graph required significant cleanup: 69 nodes removed (49 duplicate migration schema-nodes, 20 graphify cache 'data' nodes, 20 graphify config artifacts - some overlap), 94 edges restored to reconnect orphaned table nodes back to their canonical 'file:' migration nodes (via defines_schema), and 2 dangling edges cleaned. Final graph: 559 nodes, 1009 edges, zero dangling edges, zero duplicates, zero invalid types. 70 remaining orphans are all legitimate (auto-generated wiki docs, graphify internal files, isolated project files). The original 'could not fix' issues from the merge report were correctly identified as: 20 invalid 'data' types (now removed), 55 dangling edges (genuine missing shared module nodes), and no actionable complexity issues.
